posts.title: Write cleaner promises using `Promise.withResolvers()`
posts.description: If you need to pass around the `resolve` and `reject` functions of a `Promise` object, creating the promise using `Promise.withResolvers()` is a nicer API that reduces nesting.

posts.title: How to check if a Django template has been overridden
posts.description: If you're an author of a Django package, you might find it useful to check whether a template has been overridden. Here's a little snippet that helps you do that.
